# vex

> Type-safe headless CMS built on Convex, with a real-time admin panel, end-to-end type inference, auth, ABAC — no separate backend to run.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/ianyimi/vex): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://vexcms.dev): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
